messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Adult Dose for Anxiety:
Initial dose: 7.5 mg orally two times a day or 5 mg 3 times a day.
The daily dose may be increased in 5 mg increments every 2 to 3 days.
The daily dose may be increased up to 20 to 60 mg/day.
The daily dose is given in divided doses.
Maximum dose: 60 mg per day
Triplet: ["Buspirone", "has dose increment", "5 mg every 2 to 3 days"]

The relation 'has dose increment' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's dose may be increased by the amount specified by the object entity at the frequency indicated.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
C. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
D. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
E. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
